description: Get a non-Czech company by national ID and country code. Supported: gb (CRN), sk (IČO), pl (KRS number), lt (JAR registry code; VIES/GLEIF fallback when its local store is unavailable or has no matching record), nl/it/at/es/be (VAT via VIES), de (LEI), fr (SIREN), no (organization number), dk (CVR number), fi (Business ID), ee (registry code), se (10-digit organisation number via Bolagsverket).

country.description: ISO alpha-2 code or supported country name.

id.description: National company ID, e.g. UK Companies House CRN "14356670".

name: get_company
